summary.headline: Parisian Excerpts and Stellar Longitudes
summary.text: Interpretation of the tail of Leo, the Hyades, and Antares in astrological inceptions, including their planetary temperaments and indications of success, wealth, rulers, and generals. Editorial notes identify the Parisian, Marcian, Venetian, and Parisinus manuscripts and discuss an 11th-century Constantinopolitan archetype, Palchus, Ptolemy, precession, and discrepant stellar longitudes.
